{"code": "df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Check: are there any refunded orders with converted=1?
refunded_converted = df_clean[(df_clean['status'] == 'refunded') & (df_clean['converted'] == 1)]

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_df = df_clean[df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Check: are there any refunded orders among loyal customers?
refunded_loyal = loyal_df[loyal_df['status'] == 'refunded']

# Count total loyal and converted loyal
n_loyal = len(loyal_df)
n_converted_loyal = loyal_df['converted'].sum()

# Compute fraction
fraction_converted_loyal = n_converted_loyal / n_loyal

# Print results
{
    'n_loyal': n_loyal,
    'n_converted_loyal': n_converted_loyal,
    'fraction_converted_loyal': fraction_converted_loyal,
    'refunded_converted_count': len(refunded_converted),
    'refunded_loyal_count': len(refunded_loyal)
}"}
